specification.scope: The SVCB RRset served for one DNS-AID agent name. The agent protocol of a record is its proto SvcParam when present and otherwise the alpn tokens that are not transports (h2, h3, h2c, http/1.1). A conforming RRset has exactly one record per agent protocol the publisher published, and no record names no protocol or two. All fixtures are synthetic.
sources: RFC 9460 Service Binding and Parameter Specification via the DNS (SVCB)
